title: Import Build Log
summary: Parses an external dcc or msbuild build log and folds its errors and warnings into drag-lint's stored findings
intro: Read this when a build ran outside drag-lint, for example on a CI server, and you want its dcc or msbuild errors and warnings to show up as findings in your index. Run drag-lint import-log with the log file and the project index, or use Import Build Log in the About window.

surfaces.caption: Import Build Log...
steps: Open the About and Status window (drag-lint > About)
Pick the dcc or msbuild log; its errors and warnings become stored findings

questions.ask: How do I show errors from a CI build as findings in my index?
